meta.name: Poeditcal — Midnight Editorial
meta.description: A quiet, premium dark interface that combines editorial warmth with native macOS clarity.

primary.role: primary actions, active steps, positive status

neutral.usage: warm light text over near-black backgrounds with subtle layered surfaces

color.contrast_strategy: high text contrast with low-contrast nested surfaces and sparing chromatic accents

typography.font_style_notes: high-contrast editorial serif for emotional hierarchy, restrained humanist system sans for utility

spacing.section_rhythm: large calm section gaps with compact relationships inside cards

layout.columns: single-column onboarding; 3/6/3 transcript workspace; 4-column option grids
layout.alignment_tendency: left-aligned content within centered, generously padded frames

shape.border_usage: single-pixel low-contrast borders primarily for selection and drop targets
shape.divider_style: one-pixel warm-black dividers at roughly 60 percent width contrast

elevation.shadow_style: soft ambient black shadows with no hard edge
elevation.depth_cues: surface luminance and thin borders do more work than shadows

motion.philosophy: quiet, functional motion that confirms state without spectacle

components.button_style: cream-on-sage primary pills, muted surface secondary pills, generous 14px horizontal padding
components.input_style: large dark fields with warm placeholder text and sage focus ring
components.card_style: near-black or charcoal cards with 20–28px radius and restrained one-pixel borders
components.navigation_pattern: three-step horizontal progress rail integrated into the window header
components.modal_style: centered elevated card with dim backdrop and concise choices
components.list_style: roomy rows separated by subtle dark dividers
components.component_notes: selected controls use filled charcoal surfaces; removed transcript tokens use amber strike-through rather than destructive red

aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary editorial mobile products translated to macOS

visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: strong editorial headline balanced by broad low-contrast cards
visual_language.focal_strategy: one dominant action or decision per screen
visual_language.contrast_level: high for type, subtle for chrome
visual_language.texture_usage: none; depth comes from layered warm-black surfaces

composition.hierarchy_method: serif scale, color restraint, then spatial grouping
composition.balance_type: mostly symmetric onboarding, asymmetric utility workspace
composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom with a persistent left-to-right step sequence
composition.grouping_strategy: large rounded cards and labeled sections
composition.negative_space_role: reduces anxiety and makes processing feel deliberate

imagery.illustration_style: simple SF Symbol line illustrations in circular wells
imagery.graphic_elements: waveforms, progress tracks, status dots, and fine dividers
imagery.image_shape: rounded cards and circular icon wells

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate color and surface-state changes with plain-language confirmation
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: slight surface lift or border brightening
interaction_feel.loading_style: determinate progress with rotating useful audio guidance

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: short verbs such as Choose audio, Review edit, Polish, Export
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: inviting and instructional without technical jargon

overview.fallback_strategy: static state changes with all information preserved

text_effects.description: Transcript words softly illuminate during playback

visual_effects.composite_notes: The reference relies on typography, nested dark surfaces, pill controls, and tiny color accents rather than spectacle. Preserve that restraint in the Mac translation.
